title: Kernel of the coefficientwise map of polynomial rings
statement: Let $f:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $T$ any set, and $f_T:R[y_t,\ t\in T]\to S[y_t,\ t\in T]$ the ring homomorphism applying $f$ to the coefficients ($y_t\mapsto y_t$). Then $\ker f_T=(\ker f)\cdot R[y_t,\ t\in T]$, the ideal generated by the constants $r\in\ker f$ (equivalently, the polynomials all of whose coefficients lie in $\ker f$); and if $f$ is surjective, so is $f_T$.
